text: Ascale states on its website footer that ASCALE is a brand of Pamesa Grupo Empresarial, whose site lists Ascale among the brands of the group; the group's history page says it acquired Best Surface (now ASCALE) in 2023 and created Ascale as a commercial brand in 2024.
short: Ascale is a brand of Pamesa Grupo Empresarial (Fernando Roig).

source.name: Ascale (ascale.es) website footer: 'ASCALE es una marca de' with a link to pamesagrupoempresarial.com
